open_problems.description: Predictions & Builds — the discipline's research program in three classes: 34 curated entries (17 experimental predictions, 5 applied-theory predictions, 12 unimplemented software builds) plus a 190-item whole-archive intake queue, each with sources, status, and the route to run or build it.

categories.1 experimental predictions: resolve by running a frozen protocol or checking an observable
categories.2 predictions from applied theory: resolve by watching a live system the theory was applied to

open_problems._honesty: Statuses are CURATED and hand-verified, not surveyed and not title-matched. Where a status could not be determined the row says UNDETERMINED rather than guessing. Six predictions in the companion ledger have resolved WRONG and are preserved as such.
open_problems.terms: Protocols are pre-registered with declared failure conditions. A result obtained by a third party is admissible on the same terms as one obtained here. Nothing requires permission.
